Here's a LinkedIn post for you:

---

🎉 Thrilled to announce that I've joined the CDS Hooks Project Management Committee! 

Having worked with the CDS Hooks standard since 2017, I've seen firsthand how it transforms clinical decision support by seamlessly integrating evidence-based guidance into EHR workflows. Now, as a PMC member, I'm excited to help shape the future of this vital interoperability standard and drive its adoption across the healthcare ecosystem.

To the CDS Hooks community:

📊 **Already implementing CDS Hooks?** Please add your implementation to our registry at https://github.com/cds-hooks/docs/wiki/CDS-Hooks-Availability - let's showcase the growing adoption and help others learn from your success!

🚀 **Considering CDS Hooks for your organization?** With years of hands-on implementation experience, I'm available as a freelance consultant to help you navigate the standard, design effective clinical decision support services, and ensure successful integration with your clinical workflows.

Looking forward to collaborating with the incredible CDS Hooks community to advance clinical decision support and ultimately improve patient care outcomes.

#HealthIT #Interoperability #CDSHooks #ClinicalDecisionSupport #HealthcareInnovation #FHIR #DigitalHealth

---
